What to Look for in a Home Remodeling Company

Whether you're replacing your roof, upgrading your windows, or refreshing your home's exterior, the right contractor can make a major difference in the finished result.

01

Products & Materials

Look beyond appearance and compare the materials, manufacturers, and performance features available for your project.

02

Installation Experience

Understand who will perform the work, how the project is managed, and what happens if an issue arises.

03

Warranty Protection

Review both product and workmanship warranties. Coverage, exclusions, and transferability can vary significantly.

04

Pricing & Project Scope

Compare detailed written estimates that clearly explain materials, labor, timelines, and what's included.

Why Power Home Remodeling Earned Our Top Spot

Power Home Remodeling earns our top spot by making major exterior home improvements easier to manage. Whether you're replacing aging windows, installing a new roof, updating your siding, or upgrading your doors, Power brings these projects together through one established remodeling company. With products from manufacturers like GAF, Pella and ProVia, professionally trained installation teams, dedicated project tracking, and a limited lifetime labor warranty, Power offers a compelling combination of quality, convenience, and long-term support.

Power has been remodeling homes since 1992 and today serves homeowners in 25 states, so it brings real scale and experience to every project.

Four Services. One Remodeling Company.

Windows

Custom-made vinyl replacement windows in double-hung, casement, sliding, bay and bow, picture and specialty styles. Double-pane Heat Shield glass with argon gas is built for efficiency and noise reduction, and Power sources from manufacturers including Pella and ProVia, depending on location.

Roofing

A complete roofing system built around GAF shingles made exclusively for Power, with a 50-year rating and 130 mph wind rating. Each roof includes leak barrier, underlayment, drip edge and PowerVent intake ventilation to help attic air circulate and protect the shingles.

Siding

Insulated vinyl siding with form-fitting Neopor foam, protective house wrap and fade-resistant panels rated for winds up to 130 mph. Choose wood- and stone-look profiles, cedar and accent shingles, and matching soffit, fascia and gutters for a low-maintenance exterior.

Doors

Power's Freedom Series entry doors, made in partnership with ProVia, pair a 20-gauge steel-plated slab and insulated foam core with Schlage hardware and Heat Shield glass options. Power also installs vinyl sliding patio doors with tempered, insulated glass.

A More Coordinated Remodeling Experience

  1. 1

    In-home consultation

    A Power Remodeling Consultant inspects your home and walks you through styles, colors and product options in person.

  2. 2

    Product selection & estimate

    You leave with a free written estimate that Power says stays valid for up to one year, so you can plan and compare at your own pace.

  3. 3

    Professional installation

    Once you approve the project, Power confirms measurements, orders products and schedules installers trained in local codes and regulations.

  4. 4

    Completion & ongoing support

Know What's Happening With Your Project

Project Pulse is Power's secure project-tracking app. It keeps every detail of your remodel in one place, from the first appointment through completion.

  • Monitor upcoming appointments
  • Receive real-time project updates
  • Access documents, photos and warranty copies
  • Sign paperwork electronically from anywhere

Warranty & Long-Term Support

Manufacturer product warranties

Cover defects in the materials themselves, such as window glass, shingles or siding panels. They come from the manufacturer and are transferable, and Power helps file claims on your behalf.

Power's limited lifetime labor warranty

Covers problems caused by the installation for as long as you own your home. It can be transferred to a buyer who contacts Power within 30 days of closing.

Both warranties have specific terms and exclusions. Ask for the written warranty documents and review coverage, exclusions and transfer requirements before you sign.

Potential Advantages

  • Windows, roofing, siding and doors from one company
  • Established partners including GAF, Pella and ProVia
  • One coordinated process from consultation to completion
  • Project Pulse app for appointments, updates and documents
  • Limited lifetime labor warranty, subject to terms

Things to Consider

  • Pricing comes from an in-home consultation rather than an instant online quote
  • Service and product availability depend on your location
  • Not the best fit if you want to buy materials separately and hire your own installer
  • Compare written quotes and warranty terms before committing

How We Evaluate Home Remodeling Companies

These are the factors Affordable Home considers when evaluating home remodeling companies across windows, roofing, siding and doors.

  • Service Capabilities

    Range of remodeling projects offered and how well those services fit homeowners' needs.

  • Product Quality & Selection

    Available manufacturers, materials, and product options.

  • Installation & Project Management

    How work is coordinated, who performs installation, and what support is available.

  • Warranty Coverage

    Manufacturer warranties, labor coverage, and relevant limitations.

  • Customer Experience

    Consultation, communication, transparency, and post-installation support.

  • Service Availability

    Where the company operates and whether services are available locally.
